propositions: A PreToolUse hook on the Bash tool must emit a short, non-blocking reminder when grep-family commands (grep, rg, egrep, fgrep) are invoked, surfacing Serena's symbol tools as the preferred alternative.

The hook trigger must use simple string matching for grep-family commands without pattern classification or path heuristics, and the reminder message must be 2–3 lines naming both find_referencing_symbols and the legitimate grep use-cases (string literals, line numbers).
The hook must emit JSON with additionalContext and no permissionDecision field, ensuring the reminder surfaces to the model and the grep call executes unblocked.

The hook implementation must be tracked in scripts/hooks/serena_grep_reminder.py and configured in .claude/settings.json, and must merge with existing settings (preserving env.ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH from story C).

Automated tests must verify the hook fires on grep and rg commands, does not fire on non-grep commands, never exits non-zero, and handles malformed input gracefully without emitting permissionDecision.
